changes.to: iOS UI tests pass (9/9, new long-press test); the person checks on the iPhone

# Check: iOS long-press symbols (A04-leaf790)

1. Build `iOS/` from Xcode onto the iPhone (or open the app's Try it here screen in the simulator).
2. Every letter shows a small symbol in its top right corner (q %, g &, m ? …); the comma key shows 、, the period key ?.
3. Hold g: a popup above it shows & (半角) and ＆ (全角). Lift: & is typed.
4. Hold g again and slide right onto ＆, lift: ＆ is typed.
5. A quick tap on g still types g; hold a top-row key (q): the popup fits on screen over the candidate bar.
